description: Maps tree-sitter-flix's snake_case node vocabulary onto canonical TreeKind names. Partial by design: it covers the node types the fixture suite actually exercises. Anything neither mapped nor ignored is reported as unmapped, which is a gap rather than a decision, so the report distinguishes 'not mapped yet' from 'disagrees with the reference'.

notes.name_lower: Both name_lower and name_upper collapse to Ident: the reference does not distinguish case in the tree, only in the lexer.
notes.type_reference: Transparent, not mapped: the reference wraps most types in Type.Type, which is elided on the expected side, so the consumer's equivalent wrapper must be dropped symmetrically.
notes.QName: Elided only when single-child: the reference wraps a lone identifier in QName, which tree-sitter emits bare. A multi-part QName (Foo.Bar) has several children and is kept, so genuine qualification is still compared.
notes.argument: Transparent, not mapped: canonical Argument is a single-child wrapper and is elided on the expected side, so the consumer's equivalent must be dropped symmetrically.
notes.ERROR: tree-sitter's built-in ERROR node is the counterpart of the reference's ErrorTree. Mapping it lets negative fixtures be compared on where the parsers agree an error occurred, not just on whether both failed.
